title: Testuary: Agentic Test Generation with Zero-Shot Parallelism
title_zh: Testuary：具备零样本并行能力的智能体测试生成方法

paragraphs.en: Agentic approaches for automated test generation can reach high-quality results, but they improve a given test suite incrementally, so a weak starting point may lead to many iterations or insufficient tests. To address this, we present Testuary, which provides the agentic phases with an improved starting point. Testuary first generates multiple test suites through independent, parallel zero-shot requests, checks and repairs them deterministically, and combines them into a single suite with a novel structural merging approach. A runtime-weighted set-cover reduction removes redundant tests without losing covered lines, branches, or killed mutants. After that, two agentic phases target the remaining gaps in coverage and mutation score. We compare Testuary with established search and LLM-based test generation approaches. The non-agentic first phase alone already significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art. After the agentic phases, Testuary achieves on average more than 99.9% line and branch coverage as well as a mutation score of 98.6%, significantly outperforming all compared baseline approaches. Testuary needs fewer model requests and its test suites are on average smaller and faster than those of the compared agentic approach.

paragraphs.en: High-quality test suites are essential in software engineering, as they help developers detect errors introduced by code changes right away and correct them before they propagate ( Zhu et al., 1997 ; Yoo and Harman, 2012 ) . In many software projects, however, developers do not invest in adequate testing for several reasons. For example, short-term business decisions could lead to technical debt ( Ernst et al., 2015 ) which may never be addressed afterwards ( Freire et al., 2020 ) , leaving tests under-prioritized. Furthermore, developers perceive writing tests as effortful and often de-prioritize writing them ( Straubinger and Fraser, 2023 ) . Yet, tests become urgently necessary when far-reaching changes are made, to ensure that the software’s behavior remains unchanged. Such changes could be, e.g., an update of important libraries or a migration to the cloud.

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, various approaches have been proposed for automated test generation in the past. Prominent examples are techniques from search-based software testing ( McMinn, 2011 ) such as EvoSuite ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) or Pynguin ( Lukasczyk and Fraser, 2022 ) , which iteratively search for test suites with high test coverage. Hybrid approaches also exist ( Lemieux et al., 2023 ) that combine the search with large language models (LLMs) in order to escape plateaus or local optima. More recently, high test coverage scores have been achieved with agentic approaches like CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) . However, a drawback of such systems is that agentic loops improve a given test suite (e.g., an existing test suite or one obtained via a zero-shot request to an LLM) incrementally ( Jain and Goues, 2025 ) , which means that a weak starting point can require a large number of iterations for the improvement. We expect that combining several independently generated test suites can provide a stronger starting point for agentic test generation without first requiring a sequence of agentic revisions to a single suite.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这个问题，过去已经提出了多种用于自动化测试生成的方法。 典型的例子包括基于搜索的软件测试技术（McMinn, 2011），例如 EvoSuite（Fraser and Arcuri, 2011）或 Pynguin（Lukasczyk and Fraser, 2022），这些技术通过迭代搜索来寻找具有高测试覆盖率的测试套件。 也存在混合方法（Lemieux et al., 2023），它们将搜索与大型语言模型（LLM）相结合，以摆脱平台期或局部最优解。 最近，像 CoverUp（Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025）这样的智能体方法已经实现了较高的测试覆盖率。 然而，这类系统的一个缺点是，智能体循环只能逐步改进给定的测试套件（例如，现有的测试套件或通过零样本请求从 LLM 获得的测试套件）（Jain and Goues, 2025），这意味着如果初始起点较弱，可能需要大量迭代才能实现改进。 我们预计，结合多个独立生成的测试套件可以为智能体测试生成提供更强的初始起点，而无需先对单个测试套件进行一系列智能体级别的修订。

paragraphs.en: Testuary first sends n n parallel zero-shot requests to an LLM for a given source file under test. Especially for more complex code under test, a single generated test suite often leaves noticeable gaps in coverage and mutation score. Combining these test suites yields significantly higher scores than the average individual zero-shot suite in our experiments, and starting from this stronger suite can reduce the time and model use needed for agentic refinement. To ensure that the combined test suite remains practically usable, we perform a test suite reduction with a set-cover approach ( Yoo and Harman, 2012 ) , which aims to reduce test suite runtime while retaining the coverage and killed mutants of the merged test suite. To make this possible, we introduce in Testuary a novel structural merging mechanism designed to preserve complementary tests when combining the individual suites. The resulting suite gives the two optional agentic phases a head start, with the first phase targeting remaining coverage gaps and the second improving the mutation score. At the end of each agentic phase, we merge the agent’s result with the test suite from the preceding phase and re-run the reduction, to preserve useful earlier tests and to keep the resulting test suite small and efficient.

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Testuary on a common test generation benchmark and compared it to several well-known baseline approaches, most notably CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) . The results show that already the initial phase, which merges the parallel zero-shot-generated test suites, on average outperforms methods such as CoverUp as well as search-based baselines. For example, CoverUp achieves an average branch coverage of 87.6% and a mutation score of 68.2%, whereas Testuary already reaches 98.7% and 82.9%, respectively, after its initial phase. The subsequent agentic phases increase these scores to 99.9% for branch coverage and 98.6% for the mutation score. Moreover, Testuary achieves significantly higher scores per second of test suite runtime than CoverUp.

sents.en: We evaluated Testuary on a common test generation benchmark and compared it to several well-known baseline approaches, most notably CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) .

sents.en: The results show that already the initial phase, which merges the parallel zero-shot-generated test suites, on average outperforms methods such as CoverUp as well as search-based baselines.
sents.zh: 结果表明，仅初始阶段——即合并并行零样本生成的测试套件——的平均表现就已优于 CoverUp 以及基于搜索的基线方法。

sents.en: For example, CoverUp achieves an average branch coverage of 87.6% and a mutation score of 68.2%, whereas Testuary already reaches 98.7% and 82.9%, respectively, after its initial phase.
sents.zh: 例如，CoverUp 的平均分支覆盖率为 87.6%，变异分数为 68.2%，而 Testuary 在初始阶段结束后已达到 98.7% 和 82.9%。

sents.en: The subsequent agentic phases increase these scores to 99.9% for branch coverage and 98.6% for the mutation score.
sents.zh: 随后的智能体阶段将这些分数进一步提升至分支覆盖率 99.9% 和变异分数 98.6%。

sents.en: Moreover, Testuary achieves significantly higher scores per second of test suite runtime than CoverUp.
sents.zh: 此外，Testuary 每秒测试套件运行时间所获得的分数显著高于 CoverUp。

paragraphs.en: In summary, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: Introduction of Testuary, a new test generation framework that combines test suites generated by parallel zero-shot requests giving the following agentic test generation process a head start and allowing the agentic phases to focus on closing the remaining gaps.
paragraphs.zh: Testuary 简介：这是一个全新的测试生成框架，它将通过并行零样本请求生成的测试套件作为起点，从而让后续的智能体驱动测试生成流程能够专注于填补剩余的空白。

paragraphs.en: A novel structural merging approach that enables merging and reduction of independently generated test suites, usually without any loss of the coverage and mutation score metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 一种新颖的结构合并方法，该方法能够合并和缩减独立生成的测试套件，通常不会导致覆盖率和变异分数等指标出现任何损失。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation of all three phases of Testuary on a representative benchmark set demonstrating that already Testuary’s non-agentic phase is able to outperform state-of-the-art methods like CoverUp in average line and branch coverage as well as mutation score.
paragraphs.zh: 在具有代表性的基准数据集上对 Testuary 所有三个阶段进行了评估，结果表明，Testuary 的非智能体阶段就已经能够在平均行覆盖、分支覆盖以及变异分数方面超越 CoverUp 等当前最先进的方法。

paragraphs.en: Automated test generation has been studied in software engineering for decades. In their survey, Anand et al. ( Anand et al., 2013 ) identified and described the main traditional approaches in this area, which we briefly outline in the following.

paragraphs.en: One of the earliest approaches for test generation is symbolic execution ( King, 1975 ; Clarke, 1976 ; King, 1976 ) , which dates back to the 1970s. The basic idea is to execute a program with symbolic rather than concrete input values, thereby systematically exploring program paths and deriving logical constraints. Another established line of research is model-based testing ( Utting and Legeard, 2007 ; Tretmans, 2008 ; Veanes et al., 2008 ) , in which a model of the expected behavior of the software under test is used to generate test cases. Combinatorial testing ( Nie and Leung, 2011 ; Cohen et al., 1997 ) addresses the interaction of input parameters by selecting combinations that cover input interactions up to a pre-defined size. A key empirical finding is that relatively few combinations are often already sufficient to reveal a large fraction of faults ( Kuhn et al., 2004 ) , which makes combinatorial testing attractive in practice due to its comparatively low execution cost. Methods based on adaptive random testing ( Chen et al., 2004 ; Tappenden and Miller, 2009 ; Liu et al., 2011 ) aim to distribute non-failing test cases as evenly as possible across the input domain in order to avoid clustering and thereby increase the probability of detecting failures.
paragraphs.zh: 最早的测试生成方法之一是符号执行（King, 1975；Clarke, 1976；King, 1976），其历史可追溯至 20 世纪 70 年代。 其基本思想是使用符号输入值而非具体输入值来执行程序，从而系统地探索程序路径并推导出逻辑约束。 另一项成熟的研究方向是基于模型的测试（Utting and Legeard, 2007；Tretmans, 2008；Veanes et al., 2008），该方法利用被测软件预期行为的模型来生成测试用例。 组合测试（Nie and Leung, 2011；Cohen et al., 1997）通过选择覆盖预定义规模以内输入交互的组合，来处理输入参数之间的相互作用。 一项关键的实证发现是，相对较少的组合通常已足以揭示大部分故障（Kuhn et al., 2004），这使得组合测试因其相对较低的执行成本而在实践中颇具吸引力。 基于自适应随机测试的方法（Chen et al., 2004；Tappenden and Miller, 2009；Liu et al., 2011）旨在尽可能均匀地将未失败的测试用例分布到整个输入域中，以避免测试用例聚集，从而提升检测故障的概率。

paragraphs.en: Another notable approach is search-based software testing (SBST) ( McMinn, 2011 ; Harman et al., 2015 ) , which became especially prominent throughout the 2000s and into the early 2020s. Here, search techniques such as evolutionary algorithms or local search strategies are used to find test suites with the desired properties. The search can target objectives such as high coverage or mutation scores. Test coverage ( Ivanković et al., 2019 ) characterizes how thoroughly the source code has been executed by the tests. Common variants include line coverage, which measures the share of reached source code lines, and branch coverage, which measures the share of control-flow branch outcomes taken by the tests. The mutation score, in turn, is obtained from mutation testing ( Budd et al., 1980 ; Jia and Harman, 2011 ) , where small code changes are applied to produce program variants called mutants. The score itself summarizes the share of mutants detected (i.e. killed ) by the tests.

paragraphs.en: Well-known SBST approaches are, for example, EvoSuite ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) for the generation of JUnit tests in Java and, more recently, Pynguin ( Lukasczyk and Fraser, 2022 ) for generating Python tests. What these SBST approaches have in common with the other previously mentioned traditional methods is that they achieve no semantic understanding of the program under test. In SBST, this limitation can cause the search to stagnate on a coverage plateau, which Lemieux et al. ( Lemieux et al., 2023 ) address with CodaMOSA by leveraging the semantic understanding capabilities of LLMs to generate more suitable inputs for the program under test and to overcome such plateaus.

paragraphs.en: Phase sends n n independent zero-shot requests to an LLM. Each request asks the LLM to generate a complete test suite directly for the source file under test without receiving example tests or another request’s response. These requests can be processed in parallel because none depends on another response. Then, Testuary applies test suite repair, a sequence of deterministic repair and acceptance checks, to every returned suite. Only suites that pass these checks proceed to consolidation. During consolidation, Testuary combines tests from the independently generated suites, which can cover different lines and branch outcomes or kill different mutants. It then removes redundant tests through runtime-weighted set-cover reduction ( Yoo and Harman, 2012 ) . For this reduction, Testuary measures the merged suite and records the lines and branch outcomes covered by each test, the mutants it kills, and its runtime. Using these measurements, it selects a subset with the minimum total recorded runtime that retains the merged suite’s covered lines, branch outcomes, and killed mutants. The resulting suite becomes the starting suite for the following coverage agent.

paragraphs.en: In Phase , the coverage agent starts from an editable copy of the initial-phase result. It uses coverage feedback to target lines and branch outcomes that the tests have not reached. paragraphs.en: Note that we divided coverage and mutation score improvement into two agentic phases because preliminary analyses suggested that this helps the agents focus on one kind of feedback and its corresponding tools.

paragraphs.en: Phase requests n n independently generated zero-shot test suites from the configured LLM for each source file under test, using the same zero-shot prompt. Since the requests do not depend on one another, they can be processed in parallel. When several requests begin with the same text, a prompt cache allows the inference provider to reuse computation for this shared prefix instead of processing it again ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; DeepSeek, 2026 ) . Testuary therefore completes one request first to populate the cache and then submits the remaining requests concurrently.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个待测源文件，Phase 请求使用相同的零样本提示，从已配置的 LLM 中独立生成 n 个零样本测试套件。 由于这些请求彼此之间没有依赖关系，因此可以并行处理。 当多个请求以相同文本开头时，提示缓存允许推理提供商复用该共享前缀的计算结果，而无需重新处理（Kwon et al., 2023；DeepSeek, 2026）。 因此，Testuary 会先完成一个请求以填充缓存，然后并发提交其余的请求。

paragraphs.en: Step checks first whether the generated file can be parsed. If not, Testuary can apply simple local repairs such as adding a missing body to an empty block or removing a line identified as invalid by the parser. The generated version is discarded if these repairs cannot produce a parseable file. Further, this step handles and removes duplicate definitions in the same scope.
paragraphs.zh: 该步骤首先检查生成的文件是否可以被解析。 如果无法解析，Testuary 可以执行简单的本地修复操作，例如为空块添加缺失的主体内容，或移除解析器识别为无效的行。 如果这些修复措施仍无法生成可解析的文件，则生成的版本将被丢弃。 此外，该步骤还会处理并移除同一作用域内的重复定义。

paragraphs.en: Step prevents generated tests from increasing the mutation score merely by detecting that the source code has changed. A test could for example use and compare to the code under test directly to circumvent common testing practices. Then, if a mutant changes the code under test, it causes the test to fail and the mutant to be counted as killed even though the test does not check whether the program behaves as expected. In such cases, Testuary removes the offending test. If it occurs in module-level code or a shared helper, it can affect several tests and cannot be removed together with one individual test, so Testuary discards the whole generated suite.
paragraphs.zh: 该步骤可防止生成的测试仅通过检测源代码已变更来提高变异分数。 例如，一个测试可以直接使用并比较被测代码，从而绕过常见的测试实践。 此时，如果某个变异体改变了被测代码，就会导致该测试失败，并使该变异体被计为“被杀死”，尽管该测试并未验证程序的行为是否符合预期。 在这种情况下，Testuary 会移除有问题的测试。 如果这种情况发生在模块级代码或共享辅助函数中，它可能会影响多个测试，并且无法与单个测试一同移除，因此 Testuary 会丢弃整个生成的测试套件。

paragraphs.en: Step removes instructions in the generated suite that can make the test framework skip the complete file. In Python, a module-level call to pytest.importorskip("optional_package") causes pytest to skip the file when the package is unavailable ( Developers, 2026b ) . Such a guard can be useful for optional dependencies, but it also skips tests that do not need that package. Testuary removes the guard and handles any resulting collection errors or failing tests in the following repair steps.

paragraphs.en: Step handles errors that occur before the test framework can discover the individual tests. In Python, pytest executes imports and other file-level statements while discovering the tests. An import of a name that does not exist in the code under test can therefore stop discovery before any individual test result is available. Testuary first removes file-level imports that cannot be resolved. If discovery still fails, it uses the error location reported by pytest to remove the responsible file-level statement before trying again. A test that depends on the removed statement is then reported as failing and handled in Step .
paragraphs.zh: 此步骤处理在测试框架能够发现单个测试之前发生的错误。 在 Python 中，pytest 在执行测试发现过程时会运行导入语句和其他文件级别的语句。 因此，如果导入的代码名称在待测代码中不存在，测试发现过程可能会在任何单个测试结果可用之前就终止。 Testuary 首先会移除无法解析的文件级别导入语句。 如果测试发现仍然失败，它会使用 pytest 报告的错误位置来移除导致问题的文件级别语句，然后再尝试一次。 随后，依赖被移除语句的测试会被报告为失败，并在步骤中处理。

paragraphs.en: Step handles failures reported for individual tests. Testuary removes the failing tests and runs the remaining tests again because removal may lead to further failures. paragraphs.en: The separate coverage and mutation phases are the agentic part of Testuary (see Phases and in Fig. 1 ). In both phases, the agent starts from the suite produced by the previous phase. To improve the given test suite, the agent edits the tests, executes the updated suite, and measures the phase’s metric (coverage or mutation metrics) while ensuring that no errors are introduced.

sents.zh: 独立的覆盖率和变异率阶段是 Testuary 的智能体部分（参见“阶段”及图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Before an agent starts its work, Testuary establishes the suite’s score from the previous phase as the baseline. So in Phase , the line and branch coverage values recorded in Phase are used. In Phase , the mutation score recorded for the Phase output and the source file under test are used. If a test suite already satisfies the defined goal of the current agentic phase, Testuary skips the agentic loop. Otherwise, the agent initially reads the provided test suite and starts its agentic loop which is illustrated in Fig. 3 . In Testuary, agentic loops are divided into the states Revise , Validate , and Assess so that each model request can invoke only tools that are meaningful under the current conditions. This has the benefit that it prevents the agent, for example, from measuring an untested or failing edit which saves resources. In Table 1 , we provide an overview of the tools allowed in each agentic state.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体开始工作之前，Testuary 会将上一阶段测试套件得分设为基准值。 因此，在阶段中，将使用阶段记录的行覆盖率和分支覆盖率数值。 在阶段中，将使用阶段输出以及待测源文件所记录的变异得分。 如果某个测试套件已经满足当前智能体阶段设定的目标，Testuary 将跳过智能体循环。 否则，智能体首先会读取提供的测试套件，然后开始其智能体循环，该过程如图 3 所示。 在 Testuary 中，智能体循环被划分为“修订”、“验证”和“评估”三种状态，以确保每次模型请求只能调用在当前条件下有意义的工具。 这样做的好处是，可以防止智能体例如测量未测试或失败的编辑，从而节省资源。 表 1 概述了每个智能体状态下允许使用的工具。

paragraphs.en: In Revise , the agent can inspect the source file under test as well as the working test suite and can edit the tests. After an edit, the previous execution and measurement no longer describe the current suite, so the control flow enters Validate . Reading and editing remain available in Validate , and the agent can run the tests, but it cannot measure the edited suite until that suite passes. A failing execution returns the control flow to Revise , since another edit is required. An executable and passing test suite enters Assess , where the coverage or mutation measurement is enabled. Reading remains available because it does not modify the working suite, while editing and test execution are not. After Assess , Testuary either ends the loop if a stopping condition applies or returns to Revise because another edit is required for improvement. Both agentic phases use configurable goals and stopping rules. The loop ends when its goal is reached, when its model-request budget is exhausted, or after a configured number of consecutive measurements without sufficient improvement. It also ends if an orchestration failure prevents another complete measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 在“修订”阶段，智能体可以检查正在测试的源文件以及当前的测试套件，并且可以编辑测试用例。 编辑之后，之前的执行和测量结果不再能反映当前测试套件的状态，因此控制流会进入“验证”阶段。 在“验证”阶段，读取和编辑操作仍然可用，智能体可以运行测试，但在该套件通过测试之前，无法对其编辑后的状态进行测量。 如果执行失败，控制流将返回到“修订”阶段，因为需要进行再次编辑。 可执行的、通过测试的测试套件会进入“评估”阶段，此时可以启用覆盖或变异测量功能。 读取操作仍然可用，因为它不会修改当前的测试套件，而编辑和测试执行则不可用。 “评估”阶段结束后，如果满足停止条件，Testuary 将结束循环；否则，由于需要进一步编辑以改进结果，它将返回到“修订”阶段。 这两个智能体阶段都使用可配置的目标和停止规则。 当达到目标、模型请求预算耗尽，或者在连续测量一定次数后仍未取得足够改进时，循环将结束。 如果协调失败导致无法再次完成一次完整的测量，循环也会结束。

If a check fails, the edit is not written, and the tool response explains the problem so that the agent can adjust it in the next iteration.

paragraphs.en: For the whole agentic loop, we always keep the so far best passing revision of the test suite, to ensure that later changes do not reduce the test suite’s score for the current phase objective. A failing, timed-out, score-lowering, or unmeasured revision cannot replace it. When the loop ends, the best found revision is used as the agent result for the phase-end consolidation, together with the unchanged suite from the previous phase. paragraphs.en: To keep the context size manageable during long agentic loops, we employ compaction to allow the agent to focus on the relevant information. During compaction, we retain the system prompt and recent messages but use placeholders for outdated file-read results (from tool calls) to keep the conversation history short and consistent. However, compaction changes earlier parts of the context and can therefore prevent their reuse through prompt caching. To limit this effect, we run compaction only when the agent’s state changes, because state changes also modify the available tools, which in turn substantially influences the context. Between state changes, Testuary appends new messages to the conversation, keeping earlier content unchanged so prompt-cache hits reduce latency and cost ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在长时间的智能体循环中保持上下文大小可控，我们采用压缩方法，使智能体能专注于相关信息。 在压缩过程中，我们会保留系统提示和近期消息，但对过时的文件读取结果（来自工具调用）使用占位符，以保持对话历史简短且一致。 然而，压缩会改变上下文中的早期部分，因此可能阻碍通过提示缓存重复使用这些内容。 为限制这种影响，我们仅在智能体的状态发生变化时执行压缩，因为状态变化也会修改可用工具，从而显著影响上下文。 在状态变化之间，Testuary 会将新消息追加到对话中，保持早期内容不变，这样提示缓存命中就能降低延迟和成本（DeepSeek, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Testuary performs phase-end test suite consolidation after each of the three phases. The procedure returns either a test suite that can be passed to the next phase or the final test suite. After Phase , it combines the accepted independent zero-shot suites so that complementary tests from different requests can contribute to a single test suite. After each of the agentic phases, it combines the unchanged suite from the preceding phase with the agent’s result to preserve useful earlier tests. For example, the phase-end test suite consolidation in Phase (mutation agent) receives the output suite from Phase and the result of its own agentic loop. In the following, we name these test suites pre-consolidation suites . As described in Sect. 3.3 , the kept agent result cannot score below the starting suite on the current phase’s objective. But this applies only to that objective, not to every individual covered line, branch outcome, or killed mutant. A coverage-guided revision could therefore potentially lose a test that kills a particular mutant, while a mutation-guided revision could lose a test that covers a particular line or branch outcome. Therefore, merging with the test suite from the preceding phase allows Testuary to retain those earlier tests alongside the agent’s improvements to prevent regressions.

paragraphs.en: Using this analysis, resolves name conflicts before the test suites are combined. Shareable identical definitions are kept once. When distinct definitions share a name, we keep the name for one of them, rename the others, and update the references that can be resolved. If conflicting definitions cannot be renamed safely, only one definition and the tests that depend on it can remain. Testuary favors the definition whose dependent tests kill more mutants, then cover more branch outcomes, and then more lines. Following that, in Step , we combine the rewritten test suites and remove duplicate imports.

paragraphs.en: In , we execute the test suite to check that also the merged suite passes. Tests that passed separately may fail after merging because test discovery order, shared runtime states, imports, or name bindings can change. Therefore, we remove the reported failing tests and execute the suite again whenever at least one such test was removed. Once a nonempty merged suite passes, we measure its mutation score, branch coverage, and line coverage, and record each test’s coverage, killed mutants, and runtime for the following reduction process. paragraphs.en: With reduction, we remove redundant tests to improve the test suite runtime while keeping the covered lines, branch outcomes, and killed mutants recorded for that suite. Figure 5 shows the steps involved in this process.

paragraphs.en: In , we associate each test in the merged suite with the lines and branch outcomes it covers, the mutants it kills, and its recorded execution time. We model this selection as an optimization problem in which each test is either kept or omitted. Each recorded line and branch outcome must be covered by at least one kept test, and each recorded killed mutant must be killed by at least one retained test. The primary objective minimizes the total recorded execution time of the selected tests, while a secondary objective minimizes the number of tests among equally fast solutions. To implement this method in Testuary, we use the COIN-OR Branch-and-Cut (CBC) solver ( Forrest and Lougee-Heimer, 2005 ) through the PuLP package ( Mitchell et al., 2011 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在 中，我们将合并测试套件中的每个测试与其所覆盖的代码行和分支结果、其击中的变异体以及记录的执行时间关联起来。 我们将这种选择建模为一个优化问题，其中每个测试要么被保留，要么被排除。 每个记录过的代码行和分支结果都必须由至少一个保留的测试覆盖，每个记录过的被击中的变异体也必须由至少一个保留的测试击中。 主要目标是最小化所选测试的总记录执行时间，而次要目标则是在执行时间相同的最优解中，最小化测试的数量。 为了在 Testuary 中实现该方法，我们通过 PuLP 包（Mitchell 等，2011）使用 COIN-OR Branch-and-Cut（CBC）求解器（Forrest 和 Lougee-Heimer，2005）。

It selects the passing suite with the highest mutation score, resolving ties by higher branch coverage and then higher line coverage. The chosen suite serves as the input for the next phase, or, after Phase , the final test suite.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Testuary on file-level test generation and compare its final output with traditional and LLM-based test generators. We also examine the contribution of its three phases, model usage, and the size and execution time of the resulting test suites.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Testuary, Zero-Shot Test Generation, Pynguin ( Lukasczyk and Fraser, 2022 ) , CodaMOSA ( Lemieux et al., 2023 ) , and CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) on all 45 files of the Python 3.10 subset of TestGenEval ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . These files represent test generation problems of widely varying sizes, ranging from 170 up to 5,701 lines of code. The accumulated cyclomatic complexity ( McCabe, 1976 ) across functions within each file ranges from 39 to 803. The use of this subset additionally enables us to include Pynguin and CodaMOSA in the comparison, since both tools require Python 3.10. For each file, all methods are evaluated in the same project environment using the measurement procedure described below.

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair comparison, all LLM-based methods (Zero-Shot, CodaMOSA, CoverUp, and Testuary) use the same model, DeepSeek V4 Pro accessed through the official API 3 3 3 https://api-docs.deepseek.com/ , with thinking enabled at the provider’s default high reasoning effort. We chose this model because it performs very well in current benchmarks and, as an open weights model, supports the reproducibility of our results. To make CodaMOSA and CoverUp run reliably in this setup, we had to slightly adjust them. CodaMOSA now supports the chat endpoint of the DeepSeek API, both methods now support retries on connection errors, and CoverUp gets the error message when JSON tool call arguments are malformed, so it can correct the call and keep working instead of aborting. These changes help the methods continue instead of aborting after technical failures.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保公平比较，所有基于大型语言模型的方法（Zero-Shot、CodaMOSA、CoverUp 和 Testuary）均使用同一模型 DeepSeek V4 Pro，该模型通过官方 API 3 3 3 https://api-docs.deepseek.com/ 访问，并启用了提供商默认的高推理强度模式。 我们选择该模型是因为它在当前基准测试中表现优异，并且作为开放权重模型，它支持我们结果的复现性。 为了让 CodaMOSA 和 CoverUp 在此配置下稳定运行，我们对它们进行了轻微调整。 CodaMOSA 现在支持 DeepSeek API 的聊天端点，两种方法均支持在连接错误时重试，而 CoverUp 在 JSON 工具调用参数格式错误时会收到错误消息，从而能够修正调用并继续执行，而非直接中止。 这些修改有助于各方法在出现技术故障后继续运行，而不是直接中止。

paragraphs.en: While the model is identical for all LLM-based methods, we cannot directly equalize their budgets because the methods use different stopping criteria. Pynguin and CodaMOSA are limited by search time, CoverUp by the number of prompt attempts per code section, and Testuary by the number of model responses. We therefore cap each method in the unit it is designed for. For Pynguin and CodaMOSA we set a generous budget of one hour of search time per file. CoverUp uses its default limit of prompt attempts per code section ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) . Testuary requests 25 test suites in total in Phase and allows per suite one initial generation attempt plus up to three replacement attempts, so at most 100 model responses. The two agentic phases and allow 200 model-call attempts each, which caps a full run at a maximum of 500 model responses. To still make the actual resource consumption comparable, we additionally record the number of model responses and token usage for all LLM-based methods. We discuss these results later in the paper (see Sect. 5.4 ). For CodaMOSA we added logging of the usage data returned by the API to support this. Zero-Shot reports averages over the 25 individual suites accepted after repair in Phase , providing a reference without merging. Since both the model’s responses and search-based test generation are nondeterministic, we run each method three times.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管所有基于大型语言模型的方法都使用相同的模型，但我们无法直接统一它们的预算，因为这些方法采用了不同的停止标准。 Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA 受限于搜索时间，CoverUp 受限于每个代码段的提示尝试次数，而 Testuary 则受限于模型响应次数。 因此，我们按照每种方法的设计单位对其设置上限。 对于 Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA，我们为每个文件设定了一小时较为宽松的搜索时间预算。 CoverUp 使用其默认的每代码段提示尝试次数限制（Altmayer Pizzorno 和 Berger，2025）。 Testuary 在 Phase 阶段总共请求 25 个测试套件，每个套件允许一次初始生成尝试以及最多三次替换尝试，因此最多产生 100 次模型响应。 两个智能体阶段各自允许 200 次模型调用尝试，这使得完整运行最多产生 500 次模型响应。 为了仍然使实际资源消耗具有可比性，我们还额外记录了所有基于大型语言模型的方法的模型响应次数和令牌使用量。 我们将在论文的后文讨论这些结果（参见第 5.4 节）。 为了支持这一记录，我们为 CodaMOSA 添加了记录 API 返回的使用数据的日志功能。 Zero-Shot 报告了 Phase 阶段中修复后接受的 25 个独立测试套件的平均值，从而提供了一个未经合并的参考值。 由于模型的响应和基于搜索的测试生成都是非确定性的，我们对每种方法都运行了三次。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments we also measure the runtime of the test suites. Each suite is run 30 times with pytest 8.1.1 under Python 3.10 after one unevaluated warm-up run. We report the median of the wall-clock time, and the per-run timeout is set to 600 seconds. We measure line and branch coverage of the tested source file with coverage.py 7.6.8 ( Developers, 2026a ) , and the mutation score with Cosmic Ray 8.4.1 ( Cosmic Ray Developers, 2026 ) using its full operator catalog. We follow TestGenEval’s scoring convention for Cosmic Ray ( Jain et al., 2025 ) regarding, e.g., failing tests and timeouts. Mutants without a completed result are not included in the evaluation. For each mutant the timeout is ten times the runtime of the test suite on the unchanged code, with a minimum of 30 seconds and a maximum of 900 seconds. The total measurement is bounded by 7,200 seconds. All measurements were run on AMD EPYC 7713 processors. For runtime measurements, we allocated 4 CPU cores per job and 18 for coverage and mutation measurements. Within this allocation, Cosmic Ray was configured to use 15 parallel workers.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们还测量了测试套件的运行时间。 在 Python 3.10 环境下，使用 pytest 8.1.1 对每个测试套件运行 30 次，在此之前会进行一次未评估的预热运行。 我们报告实际运行时间的中位数，每次运行的超时时间设置为 600 秒。 我们使用 coverage.py 7.6.8（Developers, 2026a）测量受测源文件的行覆盖率和分支覆盖率，并使用 Cosmic Ray 8.4.1（Cosmic Ray Developers, 2026）及其完整的算子目录来测量变异分数。 对于 Cosmic Ray（Jain et al., 2025），我们遵循 TestGenEval 的评分惯例，例如处理测试失败和超时等情况。 没有完成结果的变异体不会被纳入评估。 对于每个变异体，其超时时间为未修改代码上测试套件运行时间的十倍，最短为 30 秒，最长为 900 秒。 总测量时间以 7,200 秒为上限。 所有测量均在 AMD EPYC 7713 处理器上执行。 对于运行时间测量，我们为每个任务分配了 4 个 CPU 核心；而覆盖率和变异测量则分配了 18 个核心。 在此资源分配范围内，Cosmic Ray 被配置为使用 15 个并行工作进程。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present and discuss the achieved results of Testuary’s evaluation and answer the research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将展示并讨论 Testuary 评估所取得的结果，并对研究问题作出解答。

paragraphs.en: In Testuary’s Phase , we combine independently generated zero-shot test suites to give the following agentic phases an improved starting point. Consequently, we analyze how an increasing number of independently generated zero-shot test suites affects the quality of the merged test suites. To answer this question, we calculate the scores obtained by combining the covered lines, branch outcomes, and killed mutants recorded for one to 25 suites per benchmark file. Note that this analysis uses the individual suite measurements before structural merging and set-cover reduction. We provide evidence later in Sect. 5.3 that also after these steps all studied metrics significantly benefit from the combination.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Testuary 的阶段中，我们将独立生成的零样本测试套件组合起来，为后续的智能体阶段提供一个更优的起点。 因此，我们分析了独立生成的零样本测试套件数量增加对合并后测试套件质量的影响。 为了回答这个问题，我们计算了每个基准文件中 1 到 25 个套件所覆盖的行、分支结果和已消除的变异体组合后获得的分数。 请注意，此分析使用的是结构合并和集合覆盖缩减之前的单个套件测量值。 我们在第 5.3 节中提供了证据表明，即使经过这些步骤，所有研究的指标仍能从组合中显著受益。

paragraphs.en: For automated test generation, many effective methods have been proposed in the literature. Therefore, we analyze how Testuary compares with established test generators in line coverage, branch coverage, and mutation score. To answer this, we compare Testuary’s final test suites with those produced by Pynguin, CodaMOSA, and CoverUp. Furthermore, we are also reporting the results for Zero-Shot as an additional baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动化测试生成领域，文献中已经提出了许多有效的方法。 因此，我们分析了 Testuary 在行覆盖、分支覆盖和变异分数方面与现有测试生成器的对比情况。 为了回答这个问题，我们将 Testuary 的最终测试套件与 Pynguin、CodaMOSA 和 CoverUp 生成的测试套件进行了比较。 此外，我们还报告了 Zero-Shot 的结果作为额外的基线。

paragraphs.en: When a generated test suite from a baseline approach fails to execute, we repeatedly remove tests that cannot be parsed or that fail, and evaluate the remaining suite once it passes. The baselines benefit from this way of evaluation. Runs without passing tests receive zero line coverage, branch coverage, and mutation scores. For the statistical significance analyses, we use exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) with Holm correction ( Holm, 1979 ) across all comparisons and all three metrics within each analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 当通过基线方法生成的测试套件无法执行时，我们会重复移除那些无法解析或执行失败的测试，并在剩余测试通过时评估该套件。 这种评估方式对基线方法有利。 没有通过测试的运行将得到零行覆盖、分支覆盖和变异分数。 在统计显著性分析中，我们对所有比较以及每次分析内的全部三项指标，使用精确双侧威尔科xon符号秩检验（Wilcoxon, 1945）并配合霍尔姆校正（Holm, 1979）。

paragraphs.en: Testuary’s test generation process consists of three phases that build on one another. It starts with a phase combining independently generated zero-shot test suites, followed by two agentic phases for improving coverage and mutation score. So the question is how the individual phases contribute to the overall result. To answer this question, we compare the individual phase outputs and also analyze the differences between the consecutive phases in detail.
paragraphs.zh: Testuary 的测试生成过程包含三个相互衔接的阶段。 首先，系统会结合独立生成的零样本测试套件，随后进入两个智能体驱动的阶段，用于提升覆盖率和变异分数。 因此，问题在于各个阶段如何共同影响最终的整体结果。 为了解答这个问题，我们将比较各阶段的输出结果，并详细分析相邻阶段之间的差异。

Therefore, to answer RQ4, we analyze for each of Testuary’s phases as well as the baseline approaches the number of model requests (Fig. 9(a) ), the input and output tokens (Fig. 9(b) ), the number of tests in a suite (Fig. 10(a) ), the overall test suite runtime in seconds (Fig. 10(b) ), and the achieved scores relative to the test suite’s runtime (Fig. 11 ).

paragraphs.en: Line and branch coverage only show which code is executed by the tests, not whether the tests detect faults. To reduce this risk, we additionally measure the mutation score, for which prior work shows a relation between the detection of mutants and the detection of real faults ( Just et al., 2014 ) . This combination of coverage and mutation score matches the standard for evaluating test generation methods and is also used in TestGenEval ( Jain et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Agentic test generation methods improve a given test suite step by step, so a weak starting point may lead to many iterations. Therefore, we presented in this paper Testuary, which gives the agentic phases a head start. It merges independently generated zero-shot test suites into a single suite and then minimizes it using a runtime-weighted set-cover approach. After that, two agentic phases target the remaining gaps in coverage and mutation score.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体测试生成方法会逐步改进给定的测试套件，因此较弱的起点可能导致多次迭代。 因此，我们在本文中提出了 Testuary，它能为智能体阶段提供初始优势。 它将独立生成的零样本测试套件合并为一个单一套件，然后使用运行时加权的集合覆盖方法对其进行最小化。 之后，两个智能体阶段将针对覆盖率和变异分数中剩余的空白进行优化。

paragraphs.en: We compared Testuary against Zero-Shot, Pynguin, CodaMOSA, and CoverUp. We observed that the combined zero-shot suites improve all three metrics over the average single zero-shot suite, with most of the gain being achieved by combining the first few suites. Already after this non-agentic phase, Testuary significantly outperforms CoverUp in line coverage, branch coverage, and mutation score. After the agentic phases, Testuary reaches on average more than 99.9% line and branch coverage along with a mutation score of 98.6% (CoverUp 68.2%). It also achieves the highest scores even in the quartile of the most complex benchmark files. Testuary needs fewer model requests than CoverUp but uses more tokens, especially in the mutation phase. The resulting suites are on average smaller and faster than CoverUp’s and achieve significantly higher scores per second of test runtime than Pynguin, CodaMOSA, and CoverUp.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Testuary 与 Zero-Shot、Pynguin、CodaMOSA 和 CoverUp 进行了比较。 我们观察到，组合后的零样本套件在所有三项指标上均优于单个零样本套件的平均值，其中大部分增益来自前几个套件的组合。 即使在这一非智能体阶段之后，Testuary 在线覆盖、分支覆盖和变异分数方面已显著优于 CoverUp。 在智能体阶段结束后，Testuary 平均实现了超过 99.9% 的线和分支覆盖，以及 98.6% 的变异分数（CoverUp 为 68.2%）。 即使在最复杂的基准文件四分位中，它也能取得最高分。 Testuary 所需的模型请求次数少于 CoverUp，但消耗的更多令牌，尤其是在变异阶段。 最终生成的套件平均规模更小、速度更快，且每秒测试运行时间内的得分显著高于 Pynguin、CodaMOSA 和 CoverUp。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 compares the mutants detected by the methods rather than only their mutation scores. Each cell gives the percentage of mutants killed by the row method that are also killed by the column method. Each of the three runs of the row method is compared with each of the three runs of the column method. For each file, we average the resulting nine fractions and then average across files. For Zero-Shot, each run contributes its 25 individual suites, whose fractions are averaged within each pair of runs. An empty reference kill set has no defined fraction and is omitted, while an empty comparison kill set contributes zero. The rows of Pynguin and CodaMOSA are therefore based on 77.8% and 57.8% of the files. On average, Testuary detects more than 99.9% of the mutants detected by each baseline in this comparison. The reverse fractions are lower because Testuary detects additional mutants. CoverUp detects most of the mutants detected by Pynguin and CodaMOSA, while these detect only a small share of those detected by CoverUp.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 比较了各方法检测到的变异体，而不仅仅是它们的变异分数。 每个单元格显示的是：被行方法消灭的变异体中，同时也被列方法消灭的变异体所占的百分比。 行方法的三次运行分别与列方法的三次运行进行比较。 对于每个文件，我们对得到的九个分数取平均值，然后跨文件再次取平均。 对于零样本方法，每次运行都会贡献其 25 个独立的测试套件，这些套件的分数会在每对运行内部取平均。 空的参考消灭集合没有明确的分数，因此被省略；而空的比较消灭集合则贡献零值。 因此，Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA 的行数据分别基于 77.8% 和 57.8% 的文件。 平均而言，Testuary 检测到的变异体数量超过本比较中每个基线方法所检测到的变异体的 99.9%。 反向分数较低，因为 Testuary 检测到了额外的变异体。 CoverUp 检测到了 Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA 所检测到的大多数变异体，而这两者仅检测到了 CoverUp 所检测到变异体的一小部分。

sents.en: Figure 12 compares the mutants detected by the methods rather than only their mutation scores.
sents.zh: 图 12 比较了各方法检测到的变异体，而不仅仅是它们的变异分数。

sents.en: Each cell gives the percentage of mutants killed by the row method that are also killed by the column method.
sents.zh: 每个单元格显示的是：被行方法消灭的变异体中，同时也被列方法消灭的变异体所占的百分比。

sents.en: Each of the three runs of the row method is compared with each of the three runs of the column method.
sents.zh: 行方法的三次运行分别与列方法的三次运行进行比较。

sents.en: For each file, we average the resulting nine fractions and then average across files.
sents.zh: 对于每个文件，我们对得到的九个分数取平均值，然后跨文件再次取平均。

sents.en: For Zero-Shot, each run contributes its 25 individual suites, whose fractions are averaged within each pair of runs.
sents.zh: 对于零样本方法，每次运行都会贡献其 25 个独立的测试套件，这些套件的分数会在每对运行内部取平均。

sents.en: An empty reference kill set has no defined fraction and is omitted, while an empty comparison kill set contributes zero.
sents.zh: 空的参考消灭集合没有明确的分数，因此被省略；而空的比较消灭集合则贡献零值。

sents.en: The rows of Pynguin and CodaMOSA are therefore based on 77.8% and 57.8% of the files.
sents.zh: 因此，Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA 的行数据分别基于 77.8% 和 57.8% 的文件。

sents.en: On average, Testuary detects more than 99.9% of the mutants detected by each baseline in this comparison.
sents.zh: 平均而言，Testuary 检测到的变异体数量超过本比较中每个基线方法所检测到的变异体的 99.9%。

sents.en: The reverse fractions are lower because Testuary detects additional mutants.
sents.zh: 反向分数较低，因为 Testuary 检测到了额外的变异体。

sents.en: CoverUp detects most of the mutants detected by Pynguin and CodaMOSA, while these detect only a small share of those detected by CoverUp.
sents.zh: CoverUp 检测到了 Pynguin 和 CodaMOSA 所检测到的大多数变异体，而这两者仅检测到了 CoverUp 所检测到变异体的一小部分。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows the mean scores of each method over all runs and separately for each of the three runs, as well as the standard deviation of the three run means. As in the main analysis, runs without a passing suite score zero. For every metric, the methods rank in the same order in each run. Testuary’s run means are nearly identical. This low variance is also a result of Testuary often reaching the maximum score of 100%, which leaves limited room for variation. CoverUp varies most for all three metrics.
